title: Sun shading: wind and rain are read one by one, and an operation is a new update time of manual (spec/blocks.md 18.2 D4, D6, 18.3, 18.4): a stale storm of one wind sensor behind a good calm one is an alarm while the port's mirror shows the calm; one silent sensor of two times out; a stale manual report and the value at the start are no operation, a new report is.
note: No location (no sun, idle without alarms), alarmRelease 0, windLimit 10 (default). 'x': wind [w1, w2], manual m; at the start w1 15, w2 3, m false (the start value, manualSeen = its update time 0): alarm, retracted. 1 s: w1 stale: still known 15, the alarm stays, while the mirror block/x/wind (max over the good values) shows 3. 2 s: w1 4: calm, released at once (alarmRelease 0), idle writes nothing. 3 s: m stale: an update of manual without a newer update time: no operation. 4 s: m true: an operation (lock, state manual). 'y': wind [v1, v2], windTimeout 60 s: v1 reports at 30 s and 50 s, v2 stays silent since its start value: at 60 s (the wake at v2's deadline, with the period) v2 times out: alarm, retracted, although the port's latest update is at 50 s; 90 s: v2 reports 3, its start value again: the port's max stays 5, but wind has trigger update, so the report calls the block: released at once (alarmRelease 0), idle, nothing written. 110 s: now v1, silent since 50 s, times out (wake at 50 + 60 s): alarm again, retracted again.
